description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pembrolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, plus chemotherapy (paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel) as an option for treating triple-negative, locally recurrent unresectable or metastatic breast cancer in adults who have not had chemotherapy for metastatic disease, whose tumours express PD-L1 with a CPS of 10 or more and an IC of less than 1%. Pembrolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
